steps.title: Gloomweaver, built from the brains
steps.body: The starter pack's boss, Gloomweaver, is now made like any enemy you could make: a BossBrain with three phases built from templates and parts, and a short behaviour. Place it from the Starter pack: its behaviour comes with it.

steps.title: Its phases
steps.body: In Characters › Gloomweaver › Behaviour, its brain row is WeakPointBoss (a BossBrain). 1st phase: a melee biter. From 66%: an ambusher that climbs into the dark on a thread and drops on you. From 33%: a shooter that spits webs that stick you fast, and is quicker. When it can be hurt: afterAttack, just after it strikes. Its eye glows then; the rest of the time it is dull.

steps.title: Its behaviour
steps.body: Below, the Gloomweaver behaviour: class Gloomweaver extends WeakPointBoss. Its phase(e) says what happens as each phase begins: in phase 2 it warns you to watch above, in phase 3 it calls two Threadbacks to hang round it. Open it in Logic to read or change it.
steps.task: Find the Gloomweaver behaviour in its list.

steps.title: Fight it
steps.body: Press Play. Hits bounce off while its eye is dull. Raise your shield (Q) as it bites; when its eye glows, get behind it and swing hard. At two-thirds it climbs into the dark: walk under its thread to make it drop, then strike as it lands. (A lantern's light stuns it, and opens it up too.)
steps.task: Press Play and get it to phase 2.

steps.title: Done!
steps.body: Beat it for the boss key. Everything it does comes from the brains: change a phase's kind, its parts or its speed in Characters › Behaviour, or extend its behaviour (isVulnerable, phaseFor) to make your own boss.
